selection_notes: Both select Node 25 and explain the Fxyd6-associated input-resistance phenotype through altered potassium-channel conductance and neuronal excitability. A ties this mechanism more directly to input resistance and provides a more specific, testable channel-regulation hypothesis.
answer: Primary Zone 25. (Coro6 <= -88 AND CnrI > 1,37 AND Hr3a <=2,53 AND Flt > 1) Precision:42%.Possible causality between decreased levels of Coro6 and increased levels of CNR1 may result in increased synaptic transmission via CB1 receptors. This could potentially lead to hyperpolarization of the postsynaptic membrane, causing a decrease in excitability and, consequently, a reduction in input resistance. Additionally, decreased levels may contribute to reduced levels of HTR3A, resulting in reduced depolarization and reduced excitation. This could also play a role in reducing input resistance.
